notes.title: Version 1.0.0.16 Patch Notes & Dev Letter about English Version
notes.content:
Official Version V1.0.0.16 Update Content:

【Experience Optimizations】
[olist]
[*] Added 64 new sets of story character portraits. The portrait selection interface now supports long-press for quick switching.
[*] Added support for leaving the Assassin Organization.
[*] Messenger Pigeons now display the real-time coordinates of the relevant NPC.
[*] Added a secondary confirmation dialogue for Martial Arts Sparring with story NPCs.
[*] The in-game system menu now supports opening the local log directory. This automatically opens when reporting issues.

[*] Factions now support the relocation of their headquarters. Adjusted the logic for alliance disbandment.
[*] Optimized the performance of the Faction Member interface to prevent lag when there are many members.
[*] Added the display of Faction Level to the Faction Relationship list.
[*] The Faction interface now responds to the ESC key to exit.
[*] Faction members dispatched for expeditions can no longer take on labor jobs.
[/olist]

【Bug Fixes】
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing combat under the Spanish regional setting.
[*] Fixed the logic for switching and saving between two sets of key bindings.

[*] Fixed an issue where Willpower dropped to 0 for story NPCs after being captured.
[*] Fixed an issue where many random NPCs knew sword, blade, and spear martial arts but not fist techniques, yet had no weapon equipped.
[*] Fixed an issue where resource gathering always yielded only 1 unit.
[*] Fixed the patrol route for Capital City Constables.

[*] Fixed an issue where Faction Prisoners lacked the "Recruit as House Servant" dialogue option.
[*] Fixed abnormal dialogue for Faction Prisoners after they become house servants.

[*] Corrected the Light Kung Fu/Internal Kung Fu martial arts and Friendship Lists for Sandbox story NPCs.
[*] Corrected dialogue content and options for Sandbox story NPCs.
[*] Fixed an issue where Sandbox story NPCs did not revert to their original portraits after their Mod portraits were deprecated.

[*] Fixed the issue in the [Eternal Ambition] quest where Song Hongyu was not moved.
[*] Fixed the incorrect corpse coordinates for Tianxiaren in [Shattered Heavens].
[*] Modified the quest guidance text for [Unification of Heluo], adding a prompt indicating the need to complete [The Nation's Secret].
[*] Fixed a typo in [The Trail of the False Hero].
[*] Fixed an issue where some saves with [Enlightened Resolve · II] guidance could not accept the quest.
[*] Corrected the coordinates for Tuoba Xiao and Shen Wuxia in Sandbox mode.

[*] Fixed configuration errors for some martial arts and common moves.
[*] Fixed an issue where non-Sect NPCs were using Sect martial arts techniques.
[/olist]

Since most of the bugs for the official version have been largely addressed, subsequent updates won't be as frequent as the initial bug-fixing phase right after launch. We will return to the previous schedule of one major update per month or one every two months.
Finally, thank you all for your support. 

Wishing everyone have a good  Dragon Boat Festival! ^_^

[hr][/hr]
Dear Players, 
We want to be fully transparent about the delays in releasing the English version of Path of Kung Fu. The main challenge comes from our early development approach—significant amount of the game’s text were hardcoded into the game systems rather than being set up for easy localization. 

What This Means for Development: 
1.A massive amount of content must be manually extracted. 
2.Each system (quests, UI, items) requires separate refactoring. 
3.Localization now involves restructuring parts of the core code. 

We're simultaneously working on finalizing game content and optimizing player experience. It`s taking more time than our expect,and we are actively working on it.

A Heartfelt Thank You 
We’ve received many kind offers from players willing to help with translation. We’re deeply moved by your passion for Path of Kung Fu! Unfortunately, due to the technical hurdles mentioned above, we can’t yet provide text files for community translation. Once the extraction is complete, we’ll explore ways to involve you in polishing the localization. 
Your patience and support mean the world to us. We’ll keep you updated on our progress, and we’re committed to delivering a version that meets your expectations. 

With gratitude, 
Path of Kung Fu Team

Once again, we apologize for any disruptions and thank you for being with us.
——————————————————

First and foremost, we extend our deepest gratitude to every player who has chosen to experience Path of Kung Fu. A special thanks goes to our pioneering early access players who have supported us since the EA phase. It is your encouragement and companionship that have allowed the Path of Kung Fu development team to grow and progress.

Four years ago, driven by my passion for wuxia and real-time combat, I embarked on this project. Most of our team members are avid fans of martial arts fiction, having been captivated decades ago by the world of chivalry, love, vengeance, and heroism depicted in wuxia novels. Back then, I often wondered—if I could wield a sword and ride freely through the land, what kind of journey would I embark upon?

That long-held dream has now taken shape in your hands as Path of Kung Fu.

In the story, players are drawn into a bloody feud with the Northern Jackals after an unexpected kidnapping in Nameless Market. In Qingping Village, they catch a glimpse of the chaos plaguing the world. As they travel across the land, they gradually uncover the origins of their unique constitution, unravel the mysteries of the Imperial Guards who once dominated the martial world, and rise from obscurity to become a pivotal figure capable of reshaping the jianghu—even altering the fate of the empire itself. At the climax, faced with a decades-long conspiracy, how will the player make their move?

Will they pledge allegiance to the court in pursuit of unparalleled glory? Will they dominate the martial world as its sovereign? Or will they retire to the mountains with their loved ones, laughing over tales of their adventures? The choice lies in a single thought.

For thousands of years in China, from The Biographies of the Knights-Errant to modern writers’ depictions of "chivalry," the concept of xia has formed a shared imagination among generations of youths—a world of unrestrained heroism, where honor is repaid without regard for fame or fortune. This world, bold and free, has echoed through history and into the present.

Path of Kung Fu hopes to present such a world, where one lives by their heart. Perhaps the jianghu is a place of both purity and corruption, where grudges and debts are hard to define, and the path of righteousness is fraught with hardship. Yet countless souls, across time and space, will take that first step in pursuit of justice.

If the light of chivalry in this world dims and flickers, why not let me raise a lone lantern?

The Path of the Righteous Shall Never Be Walked Alone.

[b]With Respect,
Path of Kung Fu Development Team[/b]

————————————————————
[h3][b]Early Access to Full Launch[/b][/h3]

After more than 7 months in Early Access, with nearly 30 updates and 3 major version updates, Path of Kung Fu is officially leaving Early Access. The main storyline is now complete (with 5 possible endings), and we've added more open world content. 

Note: Steam Deck compatibility will follow post-launch. Current performance may vary.

Full Version Content
Main & Side Quests
• 15 large maps (5 sects) and additional smaller maps.
• Over 1 million words of rich storyline dialogue.
Martial Arts System
• Over 10 types of weapons.
• Dozens of martial arts styles, Qinggong (Lightfoot), Neigong (Internal Arts), martial arts combos.
• Divine techniques, the Three Talents Book system, and talents.
Clan Features
• Build your own clan, clan wars, annexing other clans, recruiting new clans, etc.
NPC Interactions
• Companions, enemies, servants, family life, and more.
Other gameplay
• Martial Arts Tournament, random events.
• Life activities: fishing, brothels, gambling houses, dungeons.
• Constables, assassins, and other engaging content.

Future Roadmap
• Expand sandbox mechanics & systems
• Update Creative Workshop 2.0.
• Free DLCs

——————————
When creating a save file, you can choose between "Standard Mode" and "Storyless Mode."
Standard Mode includes all gameplay content.
Storyless Mode disables story-related quests, and character progression will be significantly more challenging—everything must be earned from scratch. (Not recommended for new players; we advise experiencing Story Mode first before trying this.)

We extend our gratitude to the incredible modder MOTW for their portrait artwork support. We are thrilled to announce our official collaboration—MOTW will also be creating character portraits for key NPCs in the full release. Thank you for your amazing contributions!

Thank you all for your expectation and support

————————

2. notes.title: 版本更新 V0.7.0.0 创意工坊初版上线！
notes.content:
0.7.0.0版本更新内容:

【重大更新】
1.    创意工坊1.0版本现已上线，玩家可自行接入创意工坊，完成自主创作，定义角色立绘形象，编写原创任务。
2.    新增BOSS机制【化解】，部分强力BOSS将拥有独特的机制，在此机制下，会极大概率识破并化解玩家的攻击，BOSS会拥有一个黄色的劲力条，但一旦劲力条消耗完，则会陷入一段时间的“力竭”状态，此时玩家可以肆意攻击BOSS。此机制将为玩家的BOSS战斗带来更多丰富的变化与挑战！
3.    新增门派：大旗门，新增大旗门专属武学，玩家可选择拜入大旗门，新增大旗门门派系列任务，在此任务线中，玩家将身入隋东关，与大旗门共御即将来临的女真大军。
4.    新版生活技能系统上线，新增【炼药】技能，后续还会有更多生活技能开放。
5.    从本版本开始，立绘将会分为剧情立绘和动态立绘两个标签按钮，大家可以根据个人喜好决定使用哪个立绘。剧情立绘制作速度比较慢，我们会逐步更新重要剧情人物（一周大概3-4张）。

12.    新增了一批野外怪物。

【体验调优】
1.    将剧情奖励【小钰编织的青衫】由护甲类型调整为外装，并新增外装造型。
2.    调整了剧情任务【白马西行】中的部分文本。
3.    调整了剧情NPC【嬴不凡】相关的部分文本。
4.    调整了剧情任务【远行之船】中的部分文本。
5.    为无名集的失败分支添加了道具【一串铜钱】。
6.    取消了【桃花坞】、【五圣教】、【连环寨】等场景的进入前置。

【问题修正】
1.    修正了火铳武器无法长按右键进行持续子弹装填的问题。
2.    修正了玩家进行某个无名集任务分支时无法获取“铜钱”道具的问题。
3.    修正了部分任务中的描述称呼，使其文本语言风格更加统一。
4.    修正了使用手柄时点开弹窗界面时偶发的一处按键错误的问题。
5.    修正了触发任务和任务过程中黑屏转场时，按X打坐会导致焦点丢失的问题。

notes.content:

The official version of the game is expected to be launched in the middle of next year, and it is expected to be launched in English at the same time, thank you for your support and waiting for the global players. If you don't understand anything about the Chinese version, you can join our discord to communicate with us.
——————————
V 0.6.0.1 Version update

【 Major Update 】

1. Added map: Chang 'an City, added a new weapon soft whip
2. Added Chang 'an City series mission, the ship of the follow-up mission, in this mission line, players will meet Du Yan Bai again, face the legendary "exploration" rudder.
3. Added Chang 'an gang, martial arts hall, can buy houses, added other cities dart cars to Chang 'an as the end of the route, Chang 'an Fuga dungeon, execution ground gameplay configuration, Chang 'an open world events.
4. Added the corresponding forging formula of realm 8/9/10 and added the medicine of Realm 8.
5. New feature: Players can arrange companions to guard their own martial arts hall.
6. The martial arts dropped in battle has been changed from random martial arts to secondary martial arts, and the dropping probability of martial arts cheats has been adjusted.
7. Open Realm Level 8 related weapons and equipment.
8. And the new martial arts [scale five pure poison whip], [soft whip style]
9. Add new internal functions [Zhi Shan Qi]
10. Added new light work [Countercurrent 12 bodies]
11. Nameless collection Maomao adds a surviving ending branch.
12. The school store increased the school's internal skills and light skills, and the school of Martial arts was revised to the upper and lower volumes of martial arts.
13. Add identification ICONS on top of some NPCS.
14. The current player chooses to force the punch, will also give the player all auxiliary attributes.
15. Gang shops selling cheats changed to two volumes of martial arts.
16. Senior black marketeers sell cheats modified to complete martial arts.

【 Experience tuning 】
1. Some evil NPC subordinate capture options will no longer increase the player's capture value.
2. Adjusted the distribution rules of gang shops.
3. The current gang task interface will refresh the status of other tasks in real time when deleting tasks.
4. Improved friendship logic when generating world NPCS.
5. Compatibility with old files: Optimized compatibility with old files when new city NPCS, gangs, and martial arts are generated.
6. Added some text optimization for the interaction of Chang 'an Brothel dancers on the new map.
7. Added some weapons and corresponding skins.
8. Added the Sect deacon Office, and explained the pre-requirements for joining/exiting the sect behavior.
9. If Xie Zhengqing self-palace, it will normally show castration buff.

【 Issue Correction 】
1. Fixed an issue with minor family and family robbery.
2. Fixed an issue related to wild monster capture: removing boss ICONS in elite monster battles, adding traits, likes, dislikes, willpower, and in some cases no name, and failing to capture the same wild monster repeatedly.
3. Fixed a bug where the variable price of the product made it marketable.
4. Fixed a possible issue with the inventory refresh logic for all stores.
5. Fixed the issue of guard dart causing abnormal catching behavior.
6. Fixed incorrect display of prompt text for ununlocked slots in Sancai Book.
7. When capturing wild NPCS, they will correctly deduct their liking.
8. After the humanoid wild monster is free, it can give gifts normally.
9. Fixed an issue where random NPCS repeated their loyalty traits too high.
10. Fixed an issue where NPC attributes could be negative under certain circumstances.
11. Fixed a text error in the Search for Source Suppression mission guide.
12. Fixed a mismatch between NPC drawing and fashion in part of the story

————————

8. 人形野怪自由後，可以正常贈送禮物了。
9. 修正了隨機NPC義氣類特質重復度過高的問題。
10. 修正了某種情況下，NPC屬性可能為負的問題。
11. 修正了【尋源遏病】任務指引中的一處文本錯誤。

劇情調整已經全部完成！從EA上線到現在，一共經歷了十多個劇情迭代的版本更新，由於劇情調整的地方實在是太多，如果是老存檔有可能部分任務錯亂，所以建議大家重新開新檔來玩，調整後的遊戲劇情和之前的版本完全是不一樣的體驗。

notes.title: Path of Kung Fu Officially Set for EA Release on September 19th
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes of the martial world!

We hope you've all been well.

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize for the hiatus in our news updates. We've been diligently addressing some challenges during this time, and today, we would like to respond to your questions.

Due to some uncontrollable circumstances with our previous publisher, we have amicably ended that partnership. We are now pleased to announce that we have signed with a new publisher, and the Early Access (EA) version of the game is officially set for release on [b][u]September 19, 2024.[/u][/b]

We deeply appreciate the concern and support from all of you during this period. 
Although the game's release has been delayed from the original schedule, increasing our development costs, we have used this time to further optimize the game. We are working hard to deliver the best experience to you as soon as possible. Thank you once again for your support.

In this EA version, you'll be able to experience:

[list]
[*] Approximately [u]10[/u] large maps
[*] [u]700,000[/u] characters (in Chinese) of storyline
[*] [u]24 [/u]martial arts sets
[*] [u]12 [/u]lightness skills
[*] [u]12[/u] internal skills
[*] Additionally, we will introduce 3 story-driven sects, open-world factions, child-rearing and development, companion development, servant development, brothel gameplay, martial arts halls, the [i]Three Talents Book[/i], bounty hunting and prison escapes, as well as more interactive gameplay with open-world NPCs, and much more.
[/list]
